newsitem.title: Indonesia: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - Jan 31.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - Jan 31.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on January 31. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

Violence jolted Rengasdengklok in west Java when thousands of youths and residents went on a burning and looting rampage after reports that a Chinese woman had insulted the Moslems. No fatalities were reported in the incident, in which 76 houses and 72 shops were destroyed by the angry mob. The rioters also damaged 19 cars, three churches and burned another.
The government has asked investment bank JP Morgan to help it choose which of the two Canadian mining giants Barrick Corp and Placer Dome Inc. will develop the Busang gold mine in East Kalimantan
Demand for domestic servants have increased in the past few weeks in Jakarta because many servants have left for their hometown ahead of the Eid al-Fitr celebrations in February.

Indonesian conglomerate Bakrie & Brothers has decided to sell its 49-percent share in PT Indocopper Investama Corp, which has a stake in PT Freeport Indonesia, operator of giant Grasberg mine in remote Irian Jaya province.
Shareholders of Indonesia's retailer PT Multipolar Corporation have approved the Lippo Group unit's plan to acquire a 50.1-percent stake in large retailer PT Matahari Putra Prima.
